_comment: Hand-written demo messages shown in the app (not training data). Also listed in README section 18.

examples.title: Account suspended notice
examples.subject: Action required: account suspended
examples.body: Your account has been suspended due to unusual login activity. Click here to verify your account within 24 hours: http://secure-login.example-bank.co/verify

examples.title: Colleague sharing slides
examples.subject: Slides for Thursday
examples.body: Hi team, the slides for Thursday's review are on the shared drive. Let me know if anything is missing. Thanks, Priya

examples.title: KYC update with a short link
examples.body: Dear customer, your KYC is pending. Update your KYC now at bit.ly/kyc-upd8 or your account will be blocked.

examples.title: Running late
examples.body: Running 10 mins late, order me a coffee pls

examples.title: Genuine bank OTP
examples.body: Your OTP for login is 482913. Do not share it with anyone.
